question: The business requirements for the product management system of an e-commerce platform are described as follows: the platform contains various products. Product information includes Product ID, Product Name, Product Slogan, Product Description, Product Category, and Default Price. Each product can include multiple styles, where each style is associated with only one product. Style information includes Style ID, Associated Product ID, Style Name, Sale Price, Original Price, and whether it is the Default Style. Each product also has multiple features, where each feature is associated with only one product. Feature information includes Feature ID, Associated Product ID, Feature Name, and Feature Value. Each style contains multiple SKUs, where each SKU is associated with only one style. SKU information includes SKU ID, Associated Style ID, Size, and Stock Quantity. Each style also includes multiple photos. Photo information includes Photo ID, Associated Style ID, Photo URL, and Thumbnail URL. Through these tables, the system comprehensively manages product details, styles, features, inventory, and display images, ensuring the efficient operation of product display and sales processes on the platform.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0320

CREATE TABLE products (
  product_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  product_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  product_slogan VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  product_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  product_category VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  default_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE styles (
  style_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  associated_product_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  style_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  sale_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  original_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  is_default_style BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (style_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (associated_product_id) REFERENCES products (product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE features (
  feature_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  associated_product_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  feature_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  feature_value VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (feature_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (associated_product_id) REFERENCES products (product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE skus (
  sku_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  associated_style_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  size VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  stock_quantity INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (sku_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (associated_style_id) REFERENCES styles (style_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE photos (
  photo_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  associated_style_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  photo_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  thumbnail_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (photo_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (associated_style_id) REFERENCES styles (style_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
